test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 01 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

Ria is liked by everyone as she is very __amicable__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Unfriendly.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"amicable"** means friendly and pleasant in behavior. (मैत्रीपूर्ण)

 
 
• **Example: **We reached an amicable agreement after a long discussion.
 
 
 
• **"Unfriendly" **refers to someone who is not friendly or kind, and who may be hostile or cold. (अमित्रवत)
 
 
• **Example: **His unfriendly demeanor made it difficult for people to approach him.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'amicable' **is **'unfriendly'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Unfriendly.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Dangerous** (खतरनाक): Something that is able or likely to cause harm or injury.

 
 
• **Example:** The situation became dangerous when the storm hit the coast.
 
 
 
• **Stupid** (मूर्ख): Lacking intelligence or common sense.
 
 
• **Example: **It was a stupid mistake to leave the door unlocked.
 
 
 
• **Hateful** (घृणास्पद): Full of hate or showing hate.
 
 
• **Example:** He made some hateful comments about his rival.
